=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/lint_plan_archival_completeness.py:~160 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The new `descope_level` calculation doesn't guard against `match.group("hashes")` being `None`, which would raise a `TypeError` on malformed heading input.
  WHY: If the capture group is absent, `len(None)` crashes the lint and can fail CI unexpectedly.
- scripts/lint_plan_archival_completeness.py:line 140 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The code doesn't defensively handle `match.group("hashes")` being `None` before calling `len()`, risking a `TypeError`.
  WHY: A future regex change or malformed match could make `len(None)` crash the lint instead of handling the input gracefully.
- scripts/lint_plan_archival_completeness.py:lines 74-78, 135-148 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `DESCOPE_HEADING_RE` requires `#{2,6}`, so a single `# De-scoped phases` heading is ignored and the lint reports a missing de-scope section.
  WHY: The warning tells users to add `## De-scoped phases` even when a level-1 heading is present, which obscures the actual heading-level mismatch.
- scripts/lint_plan_archival_completeness.py:lines 140-147 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `pr_body[match.end():].splitlines()` creates a substring copy of the remaining PR body on every call.
  WHY: This adds unnecessary memory churn for large PR descriptions, though it is only a micro-optimization concern.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
